description.value:
Your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic. Immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. If you roll a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a random magical effect. A Wild Magic Surge can happen once per turn.

If a Wild Magic effect is a spell, it's too wild to be affected by Metamagic. If it normally requires Concentration, it doesn't require Concentration in this case; the spell lasts for its full duration.

The Bigger, Badder Wild Magic Surge Table
d100Effect
01Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for the next minute. If you roll a 1 on your d100 again, reroll the d100 until you get a different result.
02Roll a d100. Your weight changes by a number of lbs equal to the roll. If the roll is odd, you grow lighter. If the roll is even, you grow heavier. Your physical appearance doesn't change.
03You gain truesight with a range of 30 feet.
04You exude a terrible odor within a radius of 15 feet for 1d4 days. Any creature that starts its turn in that radius or enters it for the first time on a turn has to make a Constitution Saving Throw, on a failure it has to spend its action retching and hacking.
05An elemental chosen and controlled by the DM appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later.
06You cast Daylight on yourself. For the duration, the area of the spell travels with you.
07You cast Fireball at the highest spell level available to you (min. 3rd level), centered on yourself.
08Your body becomes ooze-like for 1d4 hours. You gain the amorphous monster trait, allowing you to move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
09Roll a d10. Your height changes by a number of inches equal to the roll. If the roll is odd, you shrink. If the roll is even, you grow. If you are male, half the result of the d10 is also added to or subtracted from your genital size as inches, using the same rules.
10For the next 1d10 days, you can cast Speak with Dead at will without somatic or material components.
11You cast Confusion at the highest spell level available to you (min. 4th level), centered on yourself.
12You regain your lowest-level used spell slot.
13For the next minute, you regain an amount of hitpoints equal to your sorcery point maximum at the beginning of each of your turns.
14Your biological gender is reversed. A Remove Curse spell can end this effect.
15You grow a long beard made of feathers that remains until you sneeze. When you speak more than one word at a time or cast a spell with a verbal component, roll a d6. On a 1, you sneeze and immediately roll again on this table. If you were casting a spell at the time, the casting fails, but you do not expend the spell slot.
16You have Advantage on Saving Throws against spells and other magical effects for 1 minute.
17You cast Grease centered on yourself.
18For the next minute, the first metamagic you use on a turn does not cost sorcery points.
19Creatures have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against the next spell you cast in the next minute that involves a Saving Throw.
20You cast Insect Plague at the highest available spell level to you (min. 5th level), centered on yourself.
21An eye appears on your forehead for the next minute. During that time, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. Additionally, when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes an Ability Check, Attack Roll, or Saving Throw, you can use your Reaction to cause that roll to have either Advantage or Disadvantage.
22You cast Otto's Irresistible Dance on yourself.
23For the next minute, all your spells with a casting time of 1 action have a casting time of 1 Bonus Action.
24You and every creature within 60 feet of you have to make a CHA Saving Throw or suffer the effects of the Slow spell.
25You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see.
26You and one creature of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of you are magically compelled into a dance-off. Both you and your target have to make a Charisma (Performance) check. A creature that is Immune to the Charmed condition can ignore this effect, but automatically loses the contest if it chooses not to dance and its opponent does. The winner of the contest gains a bardic inspiration (d12) as per the class feature. The loser has Disadvantage on the next Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw they make before the end of your next turn.
27You cast Blink on yourself.
28You cast Faerie Fire, centered on yourself.
29Maximize the damage of the next damaging spell you cast within the next minute.
30For 1d4 days, your hands trail faint rainbows when you move them.
31Roll a d10. Your age changes by a number of years equal to the roll. If the roll is odd, you get younger (minimum 1 year old). If the roll is even, you get older. If you are made younger, you have Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws, but Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws and vice versa if you are made older instead. A Remove Curse spell can end this effect.
32You conjure a kitchen utensil or piece of cutlery such as a spoon or rolling pin in a space you can see within 5 ft of you and cast Animate Objects on it.
33A beast chosen and controlled by the DM appears in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you. It is hostile to every creature other than you and vanishes after 1 minute.
34You cast Evard's Black Tentacles, centered on yourself.
35Roll a number of d10 equal to your Proficiency. You regain hitpoints equal to the total.
36For the next 1d10 days, you are under the effects of the Speak with Animals and Speak with Plants spells.
37For the next minute, you can exchange places with a creature of your choice you can see within 20 feet as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.
38For every time you cast a cantrip within the next minute, you find a gold coin behind one of your ears.
39You cast Levitate on yourself. You are treated as a willing creature for the purpose of this spell. At the start of each of your turns, you float 20 feet higher into the air.
40You cast Spider Climb on yourself, but the duration is 24 hours.
41A djinn chosen and controlled by the DM appears within 5 feet of you. Roll a d20. On a roll of 1-10, the djinn is hostile to you. On a roll of 11-20, the djinn grants you a limited wish. You can request the effect of one spell that is 6th level or lower and has a casting time of 1 action. The spell can be from any class's spell list. If the djinn is hostile, it vanishes after 1 minute, otherwise it disappears after granting your wish or after 1 hour, whichever is earlier.
42The first time you kill a creature with damage from a spell within the next minute, it explodes into fireworks and confetti, raining down {dice 1d4} sylvan candy and 5d100 gold pieces in a radius of 10 feet. For each size category above medium, increase the amount by 1d4 sylvan candy and 5d100 gold pieces.
43You can't speak for the next minute. Whenever you try, you instead belch so loudly it can be heard within 300 feet and pink bubbles float out of your mouth.
44You become semi-incorporeal for the next 1d4 hours. You can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. You take 5 (1d10) force damage if you end your turn inside an object. Additionally, you are Immune to the Grappled and Restrained conditions for the duration.
45A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute, granting you a +5 bonus to AC and Immunity to Magic Missile. This effect does not stack with the Shield spell.
46You grow additional physical features belonging to an animal of the DM's choice (such as ears, horns, or a tail). A Remove Curse spell can end this effect.
47You are Immune to being intoxicated by alcohol for the next 5d6 days.
48You cast Thunder Step at the highest spell level available to you (min. 3rd level).
49Your hair falls out but grows back with a different color within 24 hours. After another 24 hours, it falls out again and the process repeats, each time with another color. A Remove Curse spell can end this effect.
50A fey chosen and controlled by the DM appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later. At the start of each of its turns, you roll a d6. On a 1 to 3, the creature is hostile to you and your companions this turn. On a 4 to 6, it is friendly to you.
51For the next minute, any flammable object you touch that isn't being worn or carried by another creature bursts into flame.
52The first time within the next minute you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you lose a number of hit dice equal to the spell's level.
53You regain your highest-level expended spell slot.
54You and all creatures within 60 feet of you have to make a Constitution Saving Throw or become drunk for 1d4 hours.
55For the next minute, you must shout when you speak.
56A halo of glowing letters appears around your head. For the next hour, you automatically know when someone is lying.
57You cast Fog Cloud at the highest spell level available to you (min. 1st level), centered on yourself.
58Your tongue turns a silvery color. For the next 24 hours, you speak and understand all languages.
59Roll a number of d10 equal to your Proficiency. Up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you take lightning damage equal to the total.
60Your eyes glow with scintillating colors for 24 hours and are clearly visible up to 300 feet away. You can see normally in darkness and dim light, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet. If you have darkvision, the range of this effect increases by 60 feet.
61You are Frightened by the nearest creature you can see until the end of your next turn. While Frightened in this manner, your Speed is doubled and you have to immediately spend all your movement to move away from the creature in a straight line until you are at least 60 feet away from it or no longer have line of sight of it.
62A celestial chosen and controlled by the DM appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later. It seeks out the creature it can see that is closest to its own alignment and protects it for the duration. If multiple creatures are equally close to its alignment, it chooses the one closest to it.
63Each creature within 30 feet of you becomes Invisible for the next minute. The invisibility ends on a creature when it attacks or casts a spell.
64You cast Blindness/Deafness on yourself, choosing the blind option.
65You gain Resistance to all damage for the next minute.
66You and every creature within 60 feet of you gains the effect of the Haste spell.
67A random creature within 60 feet of you becomes drunk for 1d4 hours.
68Your size decreases by one size category for the next minute.
69For the next 24 hours, you replace every adjective and adverb with a form of "nice" when you speak. Every time you fail to do so, you take psychic damage equal to your Proficiency. If the time passes and you have not failed to do so (though must have done so successfully at least 7 times), you gain an inspiration.
70You flare in an intense bright light in a 300-foot radius for a brief moment. Any creature in that radius is Blinded until the end of your next turn.
71You cast Polymorph on yourself. If you fail the Saving Throw, you turn into a sheep for the spell's duration.
72You speak with a lisp for the next 24 hours.
73You cast the Mislead spell on yourself.
74A loud voice narrates your actions and thoughts for the next 24 hours. It can be heard up to 100 feet away.
75You can take one additional action immediately.
76You cast Stoneskin on yourself at the highest spell level available to you (min. 4th level). For the duration, your Speed becomes 10 ft.
77Roll a number of {dice d10} equal to half your Proficiency (rounded down). Each creature within 30 feet of you takes necrotic damage equal to the total. You regain hit points equal to the sum of the necrotic damage dealt.
78You are Immune to all conditions for the next minute.
79You cast Mirror Image on yourself.
80For the next minute, your hands become incredibly slippery. You cannot hold objects. If you attempt to, they slip out of your hands and drop within 5 ft of you. If you attempt to grapple a creature, you automatically fail.
81You cast Fly on a random creature within 60 feet of you.
82Until the start of your next turn, every creature within 30 feet of you also has to roll on this table when they cast a spell of 1st level or higher.
83You become Invisible for the next minute. During that time, other creatures can't hear you. The invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.
84For the next 1d4 days, you can change the color of any open fire within 10 feet of you to one of your choosing. The chosen color remains until the fire is extinguished, you choose a different color, or this effect on you ends.
85If you die within the next minute, you immediately come back to life as if by the Reincarnate spell.
86You break your attunement with 1d3 of the magic items to which you are attuned.
87Your size increases by one size category for the next minute.
88You cast Improved Haste on a random creature within 60 feet of you.
89You and all creatures within 30 feet of you gain vulnerability to all damage for the next minute.
90You cast Freedom of Movement on yourself.
91Your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue and you become extremely attractive to fey creatures, who will start seeking you out from miles around. A Remove Curse spell can end this effect.
92You cast Warding Wind.
93You turn into a potted plant until the start of your next turn. While a plant, you are Incapacitated and have vulnerability to all damage. If you drop to 0 hit points, you die and your form reverts.
94Your spellcasting focus turns into a banana for 1 hour. It retains all its previous properties. As an Action, you can throw it at a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The attack automatically hits and deals force damage equal to your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier. It then immediately returns to your hands. No one expects the banana.
95You become covered in thick coat of long fur that falls even over your eyes and regrows instantly when it is cut or otherwise damaged. You gain Resistance to cold damage and have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. A Remove Curse spell can end this effect.
961d4 random pastries from within a 1 mile radius are teleported into your hands. If your hands are occupied, they are dumped on your head instead.
97For the next 24 hours, you must rhyme when you speak. Every time you fail to do so, you take psychic damage equal to your Proficiency. If the time passes and you have not failed to rhyme (though must have done so successfully at least 7 times), you gain an inspiration.
98You cast Flesh to Stone on yourself. If you become Petrified as a result of this casting of the spell, you turn back to normal after 24 hours.
99You regain all expended sorcery points.
100A dragon chosen and controlled by the DM appears within 5 feet of you. It is hostile to you. Good luck.
